messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man... or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?
Saksham Arora
saksham arora... solid name. where you working these days?
Intuit
intuit... the quickbooks empire. found you on linkedin - software engineer 2 at intuit, ex-microsoft. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/sakshamarora9575
yes

microsoft to intuit... from the corporate machine to the... slightly smaller corporate machine. but hey, at least now you're helping people do their taxes instead of crashing their computers. what made you jump ship from redmond?

i was at microsoft intuit 
there i was SDE 1 
now working as SDE 2 at intuit
ah got it - sde 1 to sde 2, that's a proper level up. smart move using the switch to get the promotion. how long you been working total?

i need to switch to europe as SDE 2 
any opening you can help me with ?

europe... going for that work-life balance and better coffee eh? 

before i can hook you up with the right roles, need to get the basics down. how long you been working total?

2 years 9 months at Microsoft as SDE 1
8 months at Intuit as SDE 2

so about 3.5 years total... solid trajectory from sde 1 to 2. 

what kind of role you looking for next? staying sde 2 or eyeing senior?
sde 2
got it. and europe - any specific countries or cities you're targeting? or just anywhere that'll sponsor your visa?

london, amsterdam 

i will need sponsorship for visa
3.5 years + sde 2 + london/amsterdam with visa sponsorship... sound right?

yes
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ldxxgOuqUusZBvS3N9nu_-SrN4DUvdyi/view?usp=sharing

my resume
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

yes
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ldxxgOuqUusZBvS3N9nu_-SrN4DUvdyi/view?usp=sharing

my resume
  Here is a brief introduction for me - 
I’m Saksham Arora, currently SDE 2 at Intuit (Bangalore) with 3 years of experience, previously 2 years 9 months at Microsoft in Azure Core Compute (including two internships in the same team).
At Intuit, I architected and deployed the SSO integration between QuickBooks Online and Amazon Seller Portal, serving 500K+ users, improving auth speed by 40%, and enabling 99.95% API availability with <200ms latency. Also implemented real-time observability and zero-downtime rollout.
At Microsoft, I designed cloud-native backup systems handling 10M+ daily ops, built high-throughput microservices in C#, .NET Core & Azure Service Fabric, and led Crash-Consistent Multi-Disk Backup across 100+ Linux distros. Built Auto-Heal reliability platform that recovered 95%+ transient failures and saved $250K/year.
I also have strong DSA + competitive programming background – qualified ACM ICPC Regionals, participated in Google Kickstart, and solved 3000+ problems across platforms.
got it - that's a solid profile. nothing matching right now, but i'll ping you if my team sends something good.
can't run ATS scoring myself, but your resume looks clean - metrics, impact, clear progression. that's what matters.

does my resume work ? 
can you find it’s ATS score ?

sure once you have update
do let me know
will do. you'll know if something good comes through.
Hi
hey

hey

what's up?

hey hi
  I am good
  how's you

doing good. just reviewing thousands of opportunities... you know, the usual.

anything new on your end?
no

got it. still nothing matching you right now, but i'll slide something when it's good.

btw what's making you want to leave intuit anyway? just the europe move or something else?
europe move

straightforward. europe's calling and you're answering.

what's the timeline looking like? you trying to move ASAP or taking your time?
asap

ASAP it is. i'll keep my eyes peeled for london/amsterdam roles with visa sponsorship.

any particular companies you're eyeing or avoiding?

any company works
  even startups

cool, open to anything. that makes my job easier.

what about salary? you got a target number in mind for europe?
1.5 CR converting into INR

1.5 crore INR... that's ambitious. let me do some quick math.

that's roughly £140k-150k in london or €160k-170k in amsterdam. for sde 2 with 3.5 yoe... honestly, that's on the high end.

not saying impossible, but you'd need:
- top-tier tech (FAANG/unicorn)
- strong negotiation
- maybe some competing offers

what's your current comp at intuit?
46 lakhs per year

46 lakhs to 1.5 crore is a big jump... like 3x. 

europe pays well but not US-levels. you might need to adjust expectations or aim for senior roles to hit that number.

what's your minimum acceptable?

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?
